content.caption:
"That’s the other guys. I work the day shift."

Most people wait until sunset to worry about mosquitoes. But October is peak season across Hyderabad for the Aedes mosquito, which can spread dengue. Unlike ordinary mosquitoes, Aedes bites mostly during daylight hours and prefers breeding in clean, undisturbed water indoors.

Take two minutes today to check your indoor plant saucers, feng shui bowls, and AC drainage trays. Emptying standing water once a week stops larvae before they ever take flight.

messages.text: Why do we get bitten during the daytime lately?

They breed in clean, still water—like plant trays and coolers.
